svg.aria-label: Agent loop: ask, prepare bounded context, request model, execute approved local tools, check results, record and continue.

g.text: How a request becomes scene changes.
Each client runs its own agent loop. The shared service supplies the model.
Continue from recorded outcomes; refine or answer.

Conversation, command receipts and image assets
